title: MINOR / Watchface not centered
symptom: On a Fossil Gen 5 watch, the AAPS watch face is not centered and with larger numbers (20 and over) for the hour, part of the number is cut off. The same face from xDrip is centered.
evidence_quote: On my Fossil gen 5 watch, this AAPS face is not centered and with larger numbers (20 and over) for the hour, one part of the number is cut off.
